title: norite voice --json
description:
The machine-readable output of `norite voice status`, `join` and `leave` (M28): how the daemon's voice call stands after the command.

Versioned source of truth (CLAUDE.md rule 15): a change to what these commands print ships with a change to this file in the same commit. Every field is always present.

`join` prints the status once the call is up; a join refused or failed prints nothing on stdout and exits 4 or 1 with the reason. `leave` prints the status after the call has ended, its worker gone.

state.description: idle: no call. joining: a join under way, which another client may have asked for. in_call: connected to the voice server, which has said ready.

channel.description: The call's channel id while there is a call, or empty.

reason.description: Why the last call ended, or why the last join failed, for a person; `left` when it was left; empty when nothing has ended yet.

available.description: Whether this daemon can join a call at all. A release cannot until the instance's voice signaling exists (M33).

unavailable.description: Why not, when `available` is false. Empty otherwise.

processing.description: The call's audio processing as its join asked, from config.toml's voice keys (M30), while there is a call; null when there is none.
